Traditional tale: 神农尝百草

Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代的时候有一个人叫神农。他需要当上医，一看别的人就想帮助他们。但是，他有一个问题，他不知道什么东西能做药。神农听说一个远远的地方有一种植物，什么病人吃都会觉得身体更好。神农三个月走去，找到有植物的地方，他看到一个很漂亮的植物，又香又好看。

Expressiveness ideas:
1. When the plant first appears, add its colour and shape to make the setting easier to imagine: “开着黄色的、像星星一样的花。”
2. At the point where he has walked for a long time, add his determined feeling: “他虽然很累，可是还是继续往前走。”
3. After he sees the attractive plant, add a short thought to show his curiosity: “这是什么植物呢？”

ideas.reason: It adds a concrete visual detail without conflicting with the story.
It fittingly shows his determination during the long journey.
It adds a natural short thought showing his curiosity about the plant.
